result.topic_en: Bare calculations with symbols of the form (ab, cd) and derivatives of coefficients $a_{ij}$ and $p$-quantities, apparently working out integrability (curvature-type) conditions for a quadratic form in three variables, related to Riemann's Paris prize essay on heat conduction.

methods.what: Four-index symbols (ab,cd) as combinations of second derivatives of the coefficients $a_{ij}$ (Riemann curvature-type expressions)
Cyclic differential identity among the four-index symbols (Bianchi-type relation)
Divergence-type relations between derivatives of two-index quantities and products of lower-order terms
Expression of curvature-type terms as quadratic sums in $p$-symbols weighted by the inverse-matrix coefficients $\alpha_{\nu,\nu'}/A$
Cyclic sum of products of $p$-symbols with antisymmetrized derivatives of $p$-symbols
